'''Vladimir Aleksandrovich Kondratiev''' ({{langx|ru|Владимир Александрович Кондратьев}}; 2 July 1935 – 11 March 2010) was a [[Soviet Union|Russian]] [[mathematician]] and [[professor]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/2317|title=Кондратьев Владимир Александрович|publisher=Moscow State University|access-date=8 November 2022|archive-date=8 November 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221108175746/http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/2317|url-status=dead}}</ref> He worked particularly in the field of [[ordinary differential equation]]s and [[partial differential equation]]s.<ref name="sow">{{cite web|title=Kondratiev, Vladimir Aleksandrovich|url=http://www.mathnet.ru/eng/person35289|publisher=Steklov Mathematical Institute RAS|access-date=5 August 2022}}</ref>

== Prizes ==
* [[USSR State Prize]] (1988)
* [[Petrovsky Prize]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] (1998)
* [[Lomonosov Prize]] of [[Moscow State University]] (2009)
